text:
Maria G.: taking the 09:00 UTC release slot tomorrow. Plan: deploy feature/stream-batching + small config tweak to routing policy. expecting ~15-25m. need a smoke owner and someone on rollback if we hit perf regressions.
Akshay R.: noted. does this change touch the kv-cache config?
Maria G.: yes, toggles prefix cache TTL from 60s -> 120s for the affected routes. no schema migrations.
Jen L.: I can own smoke. will run the standard smoke checklist and the perf tokens. ping me 5m before cutover. :white_check_mark:
Tom S.: I can be on rollback standby. can we make the rollback path explicit here? last time rolling back needed an extra db pin.
Maria G.: good call. rollback plan: revert routing flag + TTL and restart proxy pool. roll command is:```bash
redwoodctl rollout revert --env prod --feature stream-batching --to-last-stable
```
Maria G.: also will have a quick deploy plan in the PR description (step-by-step, smoke steps, verification queries).
Priya K.: FYI batch capacity for that slot is constrained — we have a scheduled load test at 09:15 in eu-west. can we shift to 09:45 if needed?
Maria G.: prefer earlier to keep wave order, but if load test makes it risky we can move. can you coordinate with the load-test owners and confirm by EOD?
Priya K.: will confirm. if we stay at 09:00 I'll throttle traffic to the canary to 10% until smoke passes.
Linda P.: small ask: please annotate the rollout with the model variant ID (v3-int8) and node pool tag, so console metrics map correctly.
Maria G.: added. model=v3-int8, pool=dedicated-g4dn.
Akshay R.: quick precheck from infra — please ensure the new TTL is in the configmap diff and the autoscaler annotation is unchanged. otherwise autoscaler may downscale mid-smoke.
Maria G.: will include a CI job to validate annotations.
DeployBot: Slot reserved: 2026-03-18 09:00-09:30 UTC for @Maria G. (release_train_wave_7). Link: https://deploys.redwood/release/2387654321
Jen L.: thanks — I'll be ready for smoke at 09:05. planning to run: health-checks, 50/50 sample generation, latency histogram, and token-cost sanity.
Tom S.: standing by. if rollback needed, I'll execute the revert command and notify infra for pool restart.
Maria G.: perfect. final ask for everyone: react with :thumbsup: if this plan works or say suggest/hold if not. I'll post the PR link once it's up.
Akshay R.: :thumbsup:
Jen L.: :thumbsup:
Tom S.: :thumbsup:
Priya K.: suggest (waiting on load-test confirmation)
Linda P.: :thumbsup:
Maria G.: thanks all — will update by EOD with final slot confirm or move to 09:45.
